_doc: Named path teachers. Every technique whose req.teacher lists the id is opened by being taught (a manual is the alternative). `venues` are education.gd institution kinds (plus `barracks` for city garrisons); the institution rolls the person's name from `names`. `ways` are the terms, any one of them opens the lessons unless require is "all": gold (fee), favour (standing at the institution: students of it count 3), quest (a quest id the caller reports done). `min_path_level` and the path's own second-path gate (power_paths.learn_checked) still apply. `grants` gives something besides the lessons.

academy_magister.title: Academy Magister
academy_magister.blurb: Teaches spell-theory and the first circles to anyone who can pay, earn trust or run an errand.

bending_master.title: Stance Master
bending_master.blurb: Corrects stance and breath; resonance forms from a master come faster than from scrolls.

sect_elder.title: Sect Elder
sect_elder.blurb: Sect elders hand down the first manuals by mouth. Favour with the hall opens more than gold.

palm_master.title: Palm Master
palm_master.blurb: Does not take coin. Teaches the palm lines to disciples he has watched for a season.

drill_sergeant.title: Drill Sergeant
drill_sergeant.blurb: Teaches bracing, forms and harness drill to recruits and the willing.

knight_captain.title: Knight-Captain
knight_captain.blurb: Teaches charge and the waking aura to knights who have sworn an oath or earned their place.

beastwarden.title: Beastwarden
beastwarden.blurb: Shows how to ask a wild creature for trust, and what the link costs the mind.

second_path_examiner.title: Examiner of Second Paths
second_path_examiner.blurb: Sits the trial that lets a developed disciple widen onto a second path. Gold, standing and a proven deed are all required.
